impact: For the v0.2 re-spec drafts (T-010–T-013): (1) lockfile hard-coding is fixed under ISS-030 (canonical) — do not duplicate it here; Pattern A's T-008 half needs no action (amended, complete). (2) T-011: resolve the repair contradiction — either ship a minimal `service repair` (adopt) in v0.2 or change the mandated mismatch message to name only commands that exist in v0.2. (3) T-010 + T-013: update the blocks --json text to post-resolution facts — contract coverage exists (ISS-002, mutation-verified); the CCUSAGE_CMD runtime-validator gap is an ACCEPTED tradeoff (ISS-023, owner-delegated) — T-013 open question 6 is thereby answered: no validator lands in T-013; revisit only if own-the-parsing replaces ccusage. (4) T-013: `--cached` alters parity-governed CLI surface — require a numbered ALLOWLIST divergence entry plus replacement shipped-mode tests (the established mechanism); note the identical requirement lands on T-017's wizard (which replaces the parity-pinned bare-invocation missing-subcommand diagnostic, src/argparse.ts:308-310) when v0.3 is re-specced. (5) T-011/T-012: the daemon must not host the synchronous spawnSync runner (src/runner.ts:14,176) for 60–80 s scans — require an async cancellable subprocess boundary, or confine the sync runner to the CLI. Recorded for the phase-open sweeps of v0.3+ tickets (edit only if the current re-spec touches them): T-014 — make the 1 MB packed-tarball threshold an actual hard CI gate or drop the 'hard gate' wording (criterion 2's 'fails (or flags...)' is not a gate); T-015/T-017 — fix the doctor ordering (T-015's criterion 6 depends on a surface delivered by T-017, which is blocked by T-015); T-016 — reword the NO-GO consequence: the supported channel is registry-package extraction (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun per its own matrix), not the npm CLI alone, and per N-002 the Apple membership is already paid so the gate is purely technical (the personal-vs-organization signing-identity question remains); T-020 — the crash-loop health state must surface somewhere that survives the helper (doctor/CLI), since the breaker stops respawning the only process that draws the menubar dot; T-022 — either move the own-the-parsing spike out of Scope-In or drop the 'only hard deliverable is splitting' claim; T-017 — delete the false 'already true' claim about bare spendbar printing MCP one-liners.
resolution: Fixed by the v0.2/v0.3 ticket re-spec applied 2026-08-02: the undecided choice is decided (candidate C, T-008) and every downstream hard-coding was rewritten; the self-scope contradictions the issue named were corrected in the same pass. The full verified requirements record is preserved in this issue's impact field.
title: v0.2/v0.3 tickets hard-code the rejected lockfile candidate (choice now decided: candidate C), and several contradict their own scope
